evidence_quote: very low birth weight infants from three neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)
rationale: Sample titles (G11-7 etc.) carry no prematurity wording, but the project description states the whole cohort is VLBW infants in three NICUs, so preterm_nicu stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: preterm infants diagnosed with necrotising enterocolitis and matched controls
rationale: The 12 samples carry attribute nec: N (no NEC); the project title shows both arms (NEC cases and matched controls) are preterm infants, so preterm_nicu stands on a project-level anchor rather than the uninformative nec: N.

evidence_quote: male_subject_of_0.328767123_years
rationale: Household transmission cohort; the phenotype attribute encodes only sex and age in years and states nothing about prematurity, NICU care or health. No source supports a health_condition for these samples.

evidence_quote: early microbiome development in preterm infants born at gestational ages of 28 to 32 weeks
rationale: Value came from environmental_medium (feces [ENVO:00002003]); the PRIMAL trial description states the cohort is preterm infants of 28-32 weeks gestation, so preterm_nicu stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: Gut Microbiome of Infants in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
rationale: Value came from the BioSample title "Child stool metagenomic sample"; the project title states the cohort is NICU infants, so preterm_nicu stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: Gut residence of bloodstream infection pathogens in the NICU
rationale: Value came from exp_type: control; the project title places the whole cohort in the NICU, so preterm_nicu stands. "control" here is the case-control arm of a bloodstream-infection study, not a statement of health.

evidence_quote: Raw reads of the microbiota of premature infant mouth, skin, and gut
rationale: Value came from sample titles such as "Infant Mouth #5 DOL 59"; the project title states the infants are premature, so preterm_nicu stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: taxonomic markers that distinguished CRC patients from tumor-free controls
rationale: Diagnosis attribute takes the values Cancer / Normal / Small adenoma / Large adenoma in a colorectal-cancer screening cohort, so Diagnosis=Cancer is colorectal cancer.

evidence_quote: a cohort of 90 human subjects with either healthy, adenomatous (precancerous), or cancerous colons
rationale: DiseaseClass takes the values Healthy / Adenoma / Cancer; the description states the cancerous group has cancerous colons, so Cancer is colorectal cancer.

evidence_quote: based upon real samples from PRJEB6070 and PRJEB7774, simulated with CAMISIM
rationale: Simulated (CAMISIM) samples built from PRJEB6070 (colorectal cancer screening) and PRJEB7774 (adenoma-carcinoma sequence); the diagnosis labels Cancer / Normal / Small adenoma / Large adenoma are inherited from PRJEB6070, so Cancer is colorectal cancer. Lower confidence because the samples are simulated.

evidence_quote: colonic biopsies
rationale: disease attribute takes the values Normal / Adenoma / Tumor on colonic biopsies, so Tumor is a colorectal tumour. Quote is the sample material from the project description; no linked paper was available.

evidence_quote: healthy and tumoral colorectal mucosa
rationale: host_phenotype takes the values cancer / healthy on colorectal mucosa specimens, so cancer is colorectal cancer.

evidence_quote: Buccal and rectal microbial swabs were collected from 424 AP patients
rationale: other_cancer came from the comorbidity attribute gastrointestinal_cancer_in_past: yes. The cohort condition is acute pancreatitis, for which the vocabulary has no specific code, so other_disease is the correct value; the past-cancer flag belongs in health_condition_detail.

evidence_quote: Meta-transcriptomes of patients with pneumonia and acute respiratory infections
rationale: Value came from the bare string disease: Disease. The project title states every patient sample is a pneumonia / acute respiratory infection, so other_infection stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: Here we characterize the skin microbiome of healthy participants and ichthyosis patients
rationale: Value came from the flag "subject is affected = Yes". The affected group has monogenic ichthyosis, for which the vocabulary has no specific code (it is not atopic dermatitis), so other_disease stands with a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: A study of bacterial translocation into mesenteric fat in Crohn's disease.
rationale: Value came from status: disease. The project description names Crohn's disease as the study condition and 47 specimens are labelled creeping_fat, a Crohn's-specific lesion. Lower confidence: no per-sample diagnosis attribute and no own-data paper, so a non-Crohn's surgical case inside the disease arm cannot be excluded.

evidence_quote: Matched bladder tissue (n=79), catheterized urine (n=79), and stool (n=17) samples were collected from BCa patients under sterile conditions.
rationale: Value came from host_health_state: diseased. The description states all specimens come from bladder cancer (BCa) patients; the vocabulary has no bladder-cancer code, so other_cancer is the most specific available.

evidence_quote: case
rationale: The only disease signal is isolate: case versus isolate: control. Neither the project description ("Normal DNA-seq of human faeces") nor any attribute names a condition, and no paper is linked, so the case flag does not support a health_condition.

evidence_quote: the longitudinal alterations in the gut microbiome of melioidosis patients following antibiotic treatment
rationale: Value came from the sample alias token "Case". The project description states the case arm are melioidosis patients, an infection, so other_infection stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: stool samples collected from adults in Tanzania and Switzerland with atopic dermatitis and healthy controls
rationale: Value came from host_disease_status: Case. The description states the case arm has atopic dermatitis; one sibling sample in the same project is already allergy_or_atopy.

evidence_quote: fecal samples of preterm infants within the first week of life
rationale: Value came from a supplementary column Anemia=1, a comorbidity flag the vocabulary cannot express. Every sample of the deposit is a preterm infant in the first week of life, so preterm_nicu is the supported code; the anaemia flag belongs in health_condition_detail.

evidence_quote: a comprehensive shotgun metagenomics analysis of 57 AMD and 58 healthy controls
rationale: Value came from description: patient. The patient arm has age-related macular degeneration (57 samples, matching the 57 affected samples), for which the vocabulary has no specific code, so other_disease stands with a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: residual intestinal biopsy samples from IBD patients
rationale: Value came from host_health_state: diseased. The description states all biopsies come from IBD patients (Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis and IBD-U mixed), so ibd_unspecified is the correct parent code.

evidence_quote: we longitudinally sampled 14 SARS-CoV-2-positive subjects who remained outpatient and 4 household controls
rationale: Value came from description: Case. The own-data paper states the case arm are SARS-CoV-2-positive outpatients, so other_infection stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: T1D + normal weight
rationale: All 31 samples currently coded autoimmune_inflammatory from autoimmune_disease_any: yes carry analysis_disease_stage: T1D + normal weight (verified for all 31); their siblings with "T1D + overweight" are already type1_diabetes.

evidence_quote: the differences beween healthy controls and TB patients
rationale: Value came from the sample-title token "Patient". The project description states the patient arm has tuberculosis, so other_infection stands on a project-level anchor. Quote reproduces the misspelling in the source.

evidence_quote: The study included stool samples from 106 ME/CFS cases
rationale: Value came from the flag mecfs_status: Y. The own-data paper states the 106 cases are ME/CFS patients (matching the 106 samples); the vocabulary has no ME/CFS code and neurological_psychiatric is the code used for ME/CFS elsewhere in the catalog and by prior curated resources.

evidence_quote: and 91 healthy control individuals recruited from 5 sites in the United States
rationale: Value came from the flag mecfs_status: N, which states only the absence of ME/CFS. The own-data paper states the 91 controls are healthy individuals (matching the 91 samples), so healthy_control stands on a project-level anchor.

evidence_quote: two cohorts of ME/CFS patients - those with short-term disease (<4 years, n=75), and patients with long-term disease (>10y, n=79)
rationale: Value came from illness_duration: Short / Long, which the description identifies as the two ME/CFS patient cohorts (controls carry illness_duration: Control and are already healthy_control). ME/CFS is coded neurological_psychiatric.

evidence_quote: Fecal metagenomic profiles in subgroups of patients with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
rationale: Found by searching study titles for fatigue / ME/CFS. The 50 samples carry external.cmd disease: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome; ME/CFS is coded neurological_psychiatric for consistency with the rest of the catalog.

evidence_quote: Severe ME/CFS
rationale: The three samples with BioSample description "Severe ME/CFS" (SAMEA112184161, SAMEA112184159, SAMEA112184158) are ME/CFS patients; coded neurological_psychiatric for consistency with the sibling deposit PRJEB57952.

evidence_quote: Diagnosed with IBS and severe ME/CFS
rationale: The four samples (SAMEA112184154, SAMEA112184156, SAMEA112184152, SAMEA112184150) state both diagnoses; the cohort condition of this ME/CFS virome study is ME/CFS, so the single health_condition code is neurological_psychiatric and the IBS comorbidity stays in health_condition_detail.
